title: Provider bank entry manifest
description: Everything needed to install one credential provider into a running deployment. An entry is data: holding only bank/<name>/ and a running stack must be enough to install it without reading anything else in this repo.

schema_version.description: Generation of this manifest contract. An installer supports a fixed set and REFUSES anything higher — a manifest from the future may declare a control the installer would silently skip, and an install missing a control is worse than one that refuses to run. An integer, not a semver: this is a compatibility generation, and a minor number invites 'close enough', which is the judgement call this field exists to remove. Carried per entry rather than once for the bank because an entry must be self-describing — bank/<name>/ copied out on its own is still installable, and still says what it is. Bump on any change an installer must act on: a new field, a changed meaning, a changed directory convention. Not for rewording a description. It should move on the order of never.

name.description: Identity of the entry. Must equal the directory name and every file basename inside it. Uninstall and check-drift resolve by this.

min_stack.description: Lowest stack tag whose IMAGE satisfies this entry's imports. Installing into a deployment pinned below it fails at runtime, not at install.

load_band.description: Which numeric band the proxy addon is installed into. policy=000-009, provider=010-899, post=900+. The installer picks the slot; the bank never bakes a number in.

hosts.description: Exact hostnames the proxy addon matches. Load-bearing: seeds 001_allowlist.py, and is cross-checked against the quoted hostname literals in the addon.

secrets.description: Values that live in a file under the secrets dir, 0600, prompted with no echo, never in argv.

multiline.description: A PEM needs a different prompt widget from a token.

config.description: Non-secret values that live in .env, passed by value.

broker_routes.description: EVERY route the broker provider registers, each flagged for whether cred-gateway whitelists it. Listing only the exposed ones would make this documentation; listing all of them makes it a control.

exposed.description: true: must appear as an exact-match `location =` in this entry's .conf. false: must appear in NO .conf, in any entry.

lab_env.description: Environment for the lab service. Values are literals; a real credential here is a lint failure.

lab_setup.description: Shell fragment run inside the lab container on create. Permitted because it runs on the untrusted side already — it can do nothing the lab could not already do.
